description: This is a simple, sturdy bar stool crafted from light-colored wood. It features a flat, square seat supported by four straight legs. Horizontal wooden braces connect the legs, providing additional stability and a subtle visual detail. The overall design is minimalist and functional, emphasizing the natural grain and color of the wood. Its clean lines and unadorned structure make it a versatile piece that can complement various interior styles. The stool's height suggests it is intended for use at a bar or a high counter.
